context.transcript:
Thanks for attending this management meeting.
You may have seen from the agenda that the responses to our employee questionnaire are in.
For the most part, comments were positive.
Staff members indicated that they are happy working at our bank.
However, many recent hires noted challenges they encountered. when they first started, especially with learning to use our computer system.
Given these concerns, I've set a goal of updating our training program to make it more effective.
Our next agenda item is the annual report which will be coming out on Friday.
I'd like you all to take some time to review it before our next management meeting.
We'll discuss it then.
context.transcript_translation:
感谢各位参加这次管理会议。
大家可能从议程中看到，我们的员工问卷调查回复已经收到了。
大部分评论都是积极的。
员工们表示他们在我们银行工作很开心。
然而，许多新入职的员工提到他们在刚开始时遇到了一些挑战，特别是在学习使用我们的计算机系统方面。
鉴于这些担忧，我设定了一个目标，就是更新我们的培训计划，让它更有效。
我们下一个议程项目是年度报告，它将在周五发布。
我想请大家抽出时间在下次管理会议前审阅一下这份报告。
届时我们会讨论它。
